LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 6.1.1 LISTENING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for Information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for Information, part of Strand 6 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How should we take care of people in the community? 2. What is the importance of vocabulary in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly with peers to identify special and vulnerable groups in the society from an audio recording,

2. listen to an oral text from the teacher and identify ways of caring for the special and vulnerable groups,

3. list words related to the theme on flashcards or vocabulary charts,

4. collaborate with peers to discuss the meaning of vocabulary identified,

5. create sentences using vocabulary and read them aloud,

6. role play a scene on translating information from an elderly person using the national or official language. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly with peers to identify special and vulnerable groups in the society from an audio recording,
2. listen to an oral text from the teacher and identify ways of caring for the special and vulnerable groups,
3. list words related to the theme on flashcards or vocabulary charts,
4. collaborate with peers to discuss the meaning of vocabulary identified,
5. create sentences using vocabulary and read them aloud,
6. role play a scene on translating information from an elderly person using the national or official language. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for Information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner engages actively with peers when identifying ways of

caring for the special and vulnerable groups.

• Learning to Learn: This is promoted as the learner engages in collective learning when role playing a scene on translating

information from an elderly person to the national or official language.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner takes different roles when listing words related to the theme on flashcards or

vocabulary charts.

• Social justice: This is enhanced as the learner accords equal opportunities to peers when creating sentences using vocabulary

and reads them aloud.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Human rights education: This is promoted as the learner is exposed to issues of concern to special and vulnerable groups and

ways of taking initiative to care for them.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the content on special and vulnerable groups to their learning in Religious Education.
